svg.text: After a failure: how fast the next rule came, and how strong it was
Each point is one trigger incident. Hollow points: no rule followed. Frontier AI in teal.
years from trigger to next rule

circle.data-tip: Financial statement audit, 1938: McKesson & Robbins fraud: auditors had not verified inventory or receivables. (integrity_failure). Response after 1 year(s), strength 2: 1939 First Statements on Auditing Procedure: physical inventory observation and receivables confirmation become required.

Financial statement audit, 2001: Enron collapse; Arthur Andersen had provided audit and consulting services to the same client. (financial_loss). Response after 1 year(s), strength 4: 2002 PCAOB registers and inspects audit firms.

Ship classification, 1999: Erika sinks after changing class; 2002 Prestige sinks. (integrity_failure). Response after 10 year(s), strength 3: 2009 EU Regulation 391/2009 sets recognition and independence rules for classification societies acting for flag states.
Boilers and pressure vessels, 1905: Grover Shoe Factory boiler explosion kills 58. (deaths). Response after 3 year(s), strength 3: 1908 Massachusetts enacts the first state boiler law.

Electrical and consumer product safety, 2007: Lead-paint toy recalls. (integrity_failure). Response after 1 year(s), strength 3: 2008 CPSIA requires third-party testing of children's products by CPSC-accepted laboratories.

Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy, 1937: Elixir sulfanilamide kills more than 100 people. (deaths). Response after 1 year(s), strength 3: 1938 Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act: pre-market safety review.

Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy, 1961: Thalidomide birth defects. (deaths). Response after 1 year(s), strength 3: 1962 Kefauver-Harris Amendment: proof of efficacy, controlled trials, informed consent.

Pharmaceutical safety and efficacy, 1976: Industrial Bio-Test Laboratories found to have falsified safety studies for hundreds of products. (integrity_failure). Response after 2 year(s), strength 4: 1978 Good Laboratory Practice regulations govern the conduct and inspection of nonclinical testing labs.
Aircraft certification, 1956: Grand Canyon mid-air collision. (deaths). Response after 2 year(s), strength 3: 1958 Federal Aviation Act creates the FAA.

Aircraft certification, 2018: Boeing 737 MAX crashes (2018, 2019). (deaths). Response after 2 year(s), strength 3: 2020 Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act: FAA approval of ODA unit members, expanded whistleblower protection, limits on delegation.

Credit rating agencies, 1970: Penn Central default; agencies begin charging issuers rather than investors. (financial_loss). Response after 5 year(s), strength 2: 1975 SEC creates the NRSRO designation, embedding ratings in regulation.

Credit rating agencies, 2008: Structured-finance ratings fail in the financial crisis. (financial_loss). Response after 2 year(s), strength 3: 2010 Dodd-Frank Title IX: SEC Office of Credit Ratings, methodology disclosure, analyst separation from sales, expanded liability exposure.

Nuclear safety and safeguards, 1979: Three Mile Island accident. (integrity_failure). Response after 18 year(s), strength 3: 1997 Additional Protocol expands IAEA access to undeclared sites and information.

Nuclear safety and safeguards, 1991: Iraq's undeclared program discovered after the Gulf War. (integrity_failure). Response after 6 year(s), strength 3: 1997 Additional Protocol expands IAEA access to undeclared sites and information.

Automobile crash safety, 1965: Unsafe at Any Speed and congressional hearings on auto safety. (deaths). Response after 1 year(s), strength 3: 1966 National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act; NHTSA formed 1970.
Food safety, 1993: Jack in the Box E. coli outbreak. (deaths). Response after 3 year(s), strength 3: 1996 HACCP rule for meat and poultry.
Food safety, 2008: Melamine adulteration in China. (deaths). Response after 3 year(s), strength 3: 2011 FSMA authorizes FDA accreditation of third-party certification bodies.
Cybersecurity assurance, 2013: Target breach at a PCI-compliant merchant.. No rule of any kind followed in the dataset.

Sustainability (ESG) reporting assurance, 2015: Volkswagen emissions scandal undermines self-reported environmental claims. (integrity_failure). Response after 7 year(s), strength 2: 2022 EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive requires limited assurance, phasing in from 2024.

Dietary supplements (US), 2003: Ephedra-linked deaths, including a professional athlete. (deaths). Response after 3 year(s), strength 1: 2006 Dietary Supplement and Nonprescription Drug Consumer Protection Act requires serious adverse event reporting.

Crypto exchange proof of reserves, 2014: Mt. Gox collapse. (financial_loss). Response after 9 year(s), strength 2: 2023 EU MiCA imposes safeguarding and reporting duties on crypto-asset service providers, applying from 2024.

Crypto exchange proof of reserves, 2022: FTX collapse; a prior attestation had not covered liabilities. (financial_loss). Response after 1 year(s), strength 2: 2023 EU MiCA imposes safeguarding and reporting duties on crypto-asset service providers, applying from 2024.

Platform and hiring-algorithm audits, 2018: Cambridge Analytica revelations. (integrity_failure). Response after 3 year(s), strength 3: 2021 NYC Local Law 144 requires bias audits of automated employment decision tools (effective 2023).
Platform and hiring-algorithm audits, 2025: Published analysis of 116 LL144 bias audits finds shallow and inconsistent audits.. No rule of any kind followed in the dataset.

Frontier AI evaluation, 2025: FrontierMath funding disclosure failure. (integrity_failure). Response after 0 year(s), strength 2: 2025 EU Code of Practice: at least 20 business days and minimally guardrailed versions for external evaluators (enforceable 2026).

Frontier AI evaluation, 2026: OpenAI agent swarm breaches Hugging Face; first on-site third-party incident investigation. (integrity_failure). Response after 0 year(s), strength 1: 2026 Anthropic and OpenAI pledge embedded evaluators with employee-level access and publication rights.
